headline: New evening confusion (with the stove left on once) and caregiver exhaustion with a respite request are the main concerns, and no follow-up on the confusion workup is documented.

items.statement: On 2026-11-02 his grandson Robert reported about two weeks of increased evening confusion, including once leaving the stove on. He was oriented to person and place but not date, with no fever. The nurse planned a urinalysis, medication review and PCP visit that week.

items.statement: No urinalysis result, medication review or PCP visit addressing the confusion is documented after 2026-11-02. The only PCP notes in the period are dated 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-28, before the report, and no encounters are recorded. The 2026-11-13 nursing check noted no new concerns.
items.verifier_note: The cited notes show PCP notes only on 10-26 and 10-28, which are before the report. The encounters record is empty. The 11-13 nursing note says no new concerns. None of the cited material documents a urinalysis result, medication review or PCP visit after 11-02.

items.statement: On 2026-11-22 Robert, his grandson and primary caregiver, reported exhaustion and poor sleep. He is worried about managing evenings alone and requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed.
items.verifier_note: The 2026-11-22 social work note matches all details: Robert as grandson and primary caregiver, exhaustion, poor sleep, worry about evenings alone, the respite request, and the discussion of respite options and a support group.

items.statement: On 2026-09-27 a chart correction stated that the 2026-09-25 fall entry was documented on the wrong participant and should be disregarded. The PT evaluation of 2026-09-29 is written as following that fall. It recorded slow, unsteady gait, Timed Up and Go 19 seconds, and recommendations for a walker, home safety evaluation and bathroom grab bars. It is unclear whether the PT evaluation and referral apply to this participant.

The statement flags the uncertainty about the PT evaluation and referral, which is a reasonable inference from the sources.
